model_validity: Idealised demonstrator; not flight software and not validated against flight data. No contact dynamics: touchdown is the instant the nozzle exit plane reaches the ground. Requirements, dispersions and sensor noise are assumed values, not those of a real vehicle.
notes: Idealised demonstrator: not flight software and not validated against flight data. Requirements, dispersions and sensor noise are assumed values.
No contact dynamics: touchdown is the instant the nozzle exit plane reaches the ground, so speeds at contact are those of that instant and not of a landing-gear model.
The trace is sampled every 0.1 s (10 steps of 0.01 s); the touchdown sample is interpolated to the instant of contact. Verdicts are computed on every step, not on the samples.
Sensor channels show the latest observation of the control cycle; they are empty while a sensor delivers nothing.

vehicle.attitude: Unit quaternion [w, x, y, z], scalar first, mapping body components to inertial ones.
vehicle.body_axis: x_B points from the nozzle to the nose; it points up at the start. Stations are measured from the nozzle exit plane along x_B. The model has no vehicle length.
vehicle.position_is: pos_x, pos_y and pos_z are the centre of mass; base_x, base_y and altitude are the nozzle exit plane, which touches the ground.
